method: Manual relevance/source review of this small test sequence; not a general accuracy score.

baseline.clients: partial: some project/client phrasing is imprecise
baseline.article_summary: fail: false claim that the known article could not be found
baseline.conversation_summary: partial: repeats the earlier false article-availability claim

candidate.specialization: pass: profile focus; no claim that Tom built Cursor
candidate.clients: pass: named organizations and side/production projects
candidate.sql_experience: partial: relevant SQL discussion but an unrelated writing aside remains
candidate.article_summary: partial: correct article and useful overview; omits detailed security architecture
candidate.conversation_summary: pass: covers actual preceding discussion, memory scope
candidate.first_question: pass: exact first successful user question

limits: Valid citation IDs and model-selected sources do not prove every claim is supported.
Article summaries can miss details; technical answers can still include unrelated writing.
One sequential run per variant; shared host/cache and failed baseline turns affect comparability.
Ordinary structured final answers were buffered; no early-token streaming gain was observed.
